title: tg-analysis: A Python package for thermogravimetric signal denoising, baseline correction, and Frazer-Suzuki peak deconvolution
description:
A Python package for thermogravimetric (TGA) signal denoising with Savitzky-Golay smoothing (residual-whiteness window selection), mass-loss event detection, five candidate mass-loss estimators (endpoint subtraction, ICTAC sloped tangent, and three DTG-area baseline modes: constant, linear-blend, alpha-blend), and Frazer-Suzuki peak deconvolution of overlapping decomposition events.

Applied to reference calcite and hydrated cement paste specimens in the Thermochimica Acta short communication by Zhang and Bullard (in preparation, 2026).
